description_en: Retrieves the version information of a user
name: DescribeUserBuyVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. If you specify an instance ID, the system queries the specified instance. If you leave this parameter empty, the system queries the most recent instance by default
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。若填写实例ID，则根据实例ID查询。不填写则默认查询最新实例
parameters.name: instance_id

AliUid.description_en: The AliUid of the Cloud Firewall account

DefaultBandwidth.description_en: The default bandwidth of the edition

Expire.description_en:
The expiration time of the Cloud Firewall instance.
The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp.

This field is meaningless when you use the pay-as-you-go edition
Expire.description_zh:
云防火墙实例的到期时间。
使用毫秒级时间戳格式。

使用按量付费版本时该字段无意义

InstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the purchased Cloud Firewall instance.

This field is meaningless when you use the trial version
InstanceId.description_zh:
购买的云防火墙实例id。

使用试用版本时此字段无意义

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The provisioning status of the Cloud Firewall instance. Valid values:

normal: The instance is running normally.

init: The instance is being initialized.

deleting: The instance is being deleted. 

abnormal: The instance is abnormal.

free: No valid instance exists
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
云防火墙实例的生产状态。取值：

normal：实例正常运行中

init：实例初始化中

deleting：实例正在删除 

abnormal：实例存在异常

free：无有效实例

InternetBandwidth.description_en: The purchased traffic processing capacity of the Internet firewall
InternetBandwidth.description_zh: 购买的互联网防火墙流量处理能力

IpNumber.description_en:
The purchased quota for the Internet border protection.

This field takes effect only for subscription users
IpNumber.description_zh:
购买的互联网边界防护规格数。

该字段仅对包年包月用户生效

LogStatus.description_en:
The enabling status of log delivery. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
LogStatus.description_zh:
日志投递开启状态。取值：
true：已开启
false：未开启

LogStorage.description_en:
The purchased log storage capacity.
This field takes effect only for subscription users
LogStorage.description_zh:
购买的日志存储容量。
该字段仅对包年包月用户生效

MaxOverflow.description_en:
Indicates whether burstable elastic billing is enabled. Valid values:
1000000: Enabled.
0: Disabled.

This field takes effect only for subscription users
MaxOverflow.description_zh:
是否开通超量弹性计费。取值：
1000000：已开通
0：未开通

该字段仅对包年包月用户生效

NatBandwidth.description_en: The purchased traffic processing capacity of NAT firewalls
NatBandwidth.description_zh: 购买的NAT防火墙流量处理能力

Sdl.description_en: The enabling status of sensitive data leak detection. In the Resource field, true indicates enabled and false indicates disabled. In the API response, 1 indicates enabled and 0 indicates disabled
Sdl.description_zh: 敏感数据泄漏检测的开通状态。Resource 中 true 表示开启、false 表示关闭；API 响应中 1 表示开启、0 表示关闭

StartTime.description_en:
The activation time of the Cloud Firewall instance.
The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
StartTime.description_zh:
云防火墙实例的开通时间。
使用毫秒级时间戳格式

ThreatIntelligence.description_en: The enabling status of threat intelligence

UserStatus.description_en:
The status of the Cloud Firewall instance. Valid values:
true: Valid.
false: Invalid
UserStatus.description_zh:
云防火墙实例的状态。取值：
true：有效
false：无效

Version.description_en:
The version of the Cloud Firewall instance. Valid values:
2: Premium Edition
3: Enterprise Edition
4: Ultimate Edition
10: Pay-as-you-go Edition
Version.description_zh:
云防火墙实例的版本信息。取值：
2：高级版
3：企业版
4：旗舰版
10：按量付费版本

VpcBandwidth.description_en: The purchased traffic processing capacity of VPC firewalls
VpcBandwidth.description_zh: 购买的VPC防火墙流量处理能力

VpcNumber.description_en:
The purchased quota for VPC firewalls.

This field takes effect only for subscription users
VpcNumber.description_zh:
购买的VPC边界防护规格数。

该字段仅对包年包月用户生效
